newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-FREEMAN WINS FIRST MAJOR 400 METRES TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-FREEMAN WINS FIRST MAJOR 400 METRES TITLE.

text.p: Australian Cathy Freeman clinched the first major title of her career on Monday when she won the world women's 400 metres final.

Freeman, beaten into second place by France's Marie-Jose Perec at last year's Atlanta Olympics, fended off a challenge in the last 30 metres from Jamaican Sandie Richards and American Jearl Miles-Clark to win in 49.77 seconds.
Richards took silver in 49.79 with Miles-Clark winning the bronze in 49.90.

Freeman became the first aborigine to represent Australia at an Olympics in the 1992 Barcelona Games. She celebrated her victory here by carrying both the aborigine and Australian flags around the track.
Perec, the 200 and 400 Olympic champion, is competing in the shorter event only.
